name: Algebraic Connectivity Disguise
description: Replaced the set-partition definition of graph connectivity with an algebraic equivalent: a subset of variables is "monolithic" (connected) if the system of equality conditions between them forces all variables to take the same value. This removes graph terminology (coupled, partition, linked) and prevents models from trivially recognizing the leaf-pruning / Steiner tree structure on a graph, forcing them to deduce the connectivity requirement from the algebraic properties.
